set, and github.host is github.com or a subdomain of ghe.com
set, and github.host is a GitHub Enterprise Server host

glab holds a credential for the exact FQDN

kubernetes.when: the target declares the search path; needs no environment
set; its own path order is honoured

access_protocol.no_search: Do not hunt for credentials. Run access_check.py once: if it passes, the report names the effective source for each authority and you are done. If it blocks, the surface reason names what to fix.
access_protocol.rule: first match wins; the resolved source is reported in credential_sources
access_protocol.warning: The last Kubernetes entry is usually a DIFFERENT cluster from the one you want. Declare kubernetes.kubeconfigs in the target so a cold run cannot silently aim elsewhere.

filters_records.--search: case-insensitive text filter over the returned records

namespaced.--namespace: one namespace, or `all`; `auto` where the command discovers it

access_check.py.purpose: Prove access to every selected authority and emit one receipt.
access_check.py.returns: A receipt: credential sources, identities, targets, skill digest, and one entry per live check.
access_check.py.use_when: Before trusting any other command, and whenever you need evidence that a host really had the access it claims.

ceph_kernel.py.purpose: Classify recent local Ceph and RBD kernel journal messages.
ceph_kernel.py.returns: Bounded UTC kernel records and read-only recommended action codes.
ceph_kernel.py.use_when: A selected Linux node shows storage or RBD symptoms.

cilium_node.py.purpose: Read the local Cilium agent container, daemon status and health.
cilium_node.py.returns: One local agent record with daemon and health JSON plus component findings, or a classified failure.
cilium_node.py.use_when: A selected Linux node needs CRI-level Cilium diagnosis.

cilium_status.py.purpose: Aggregate Cilium agent, operator and node health by real exec.
cilium_status.py.returns: One record per agent with non-TTY health and actionable peer findings; UNKNOWN where exec could not run.
cilium_status.py.use_when: Connectivity is suspect, or a node's CNI may differ from its Ready condition.

event_trace.py.purpose: Return a time-ordered event trace from both event APIs.
event_trace.py.returns: One record per event, deduplicated across both APIs, oldest first.
event_trace.py.use_when: You need what the cluster said during an interval. Pass the interval; a zero count with zero errors means the events aged out, not that the read failed.

gitlab_job.py.purpose: Read one CI job with its pipeline, runner and bounded trace.
gitlab_job.py.returns: One record: job, pipeline, runner, and the last 200 trace lines, sanitized.
gitlab_job.py.use_when: A named job failed and you need its own facts, not the cluster's.

storage_report.py.purpose: Correlate claims, volumes, attachments, pods and controllers.
storage_report.py.returns: One record per claim or standalone volume, with its pods, attachments and controllers.
storage_report.py.use_when: A workload will not start or a volume looks stuck, and you need the chain.

default_output: json when stdout is not a terminal, human when it is

exit_codes.0: PASS or an explicitly marked DRY_RUN
exit_codes.2: BLOCKED or PARTIAL, or an input that could not be used

node_local_options.--describe: this command's machine-readable contract, then exit
node_local_options.--dry-run: list local commands without executing them; never live evidence
node_local_options.--human: human summary even when stdout is not a terminal
node_local_options.--search: case-insensitive text filter over returned records

status_values.BLOCKED: an authority or a required read failed; see blocking_live_checks
status_values.DRY_RUN: a probe plan only, never access evidence
status_values.PARTIAL: the read completed and a component is unhealthy; see access_proven
status_values.PASS: every selected authority and live check passed
status_values.UNKNOWN: a per-item reading could not be taken, preserved rather than coerced

target_protocol.when: passed; a missing file is an error, never a fallback

universal_options.--describe: this command's machine-readable contract, then exit
universal_options.--dry-run: list planned probes without contacting any API; never access evidence
universal_options.--human: human summary even when stdout is not a terminal
universal_options.--output-dir: write paired JSON and text reports; nothing is persisted without it
universal_options.--revision: exact source commit of the installed copy, recorded as a claim
universal_options.--target: nonsecret TOML naming the exact authorities; defaults to the per-host location
